referencePolicy: Original assets from text prompts. No video frames, private data, branded art, or external reference images were sent.

assets.name: plan-notebook-v2
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small original decorative illustration for the TrainOracle athlete training app. Create a single isolated polished matte 3D clay-and-paper object illustration, friendly premium mobile-app feel, soft tactile bevels, restrained diffuse studio shading within the object only. Brand palette deep teal #0D5F5A, warm ivory #FAFAF7, charcoal #2B3330, muted mint. Square composition, object takes 76 percent of canvas, same elevated three-quarter view, clear chunky silhouette legible at 64-80px. Genuine transparent background, no ground plane, no cast shadow beyond object, no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, badge words, decorative sparkles, confetti or interface mockup. Original design, not a copy of a branded app asset.
Primary request: A small upright spiral-bound training planning notebook with a deep teal cover, two ivory rounded page tabs, and one short graphite pencil leaning alongside. No written marks or grid numbers. A composed purposeful shape.
